mapper.sql: id, source_id, status, attempt, error_code, updated_at
mapper.select: INSERT INTO summary_tasks (id, source_id, status) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{sourceId}, 'QUEUED') ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING
SELECT FROM summary_tasks ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE summary_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', lease_until = NULL, error_code = 'TASK_LEASE_EXPIRED', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: UPDATE summary_tasks SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt = attempt + 1, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM summary_tasks WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY updated_at, id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE summary_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', lease_until = NULL, error_code = #{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt = #{attempt} AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: UPDATE summary_tasks SET status = 'QUEUED', error_code = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status = 'FAILED' RETURNING
